name: AbstractOrder
comments: Shared state for every kind of order.

name: Reference
comments: An auto-property: a value holder with no body of its own.

name: AuditedAttribute
comments: Marks a method whose calls must reach the audit log.

name: Verbose
comments: A named argument target.

name: Basket
comments: A basket being filled. Declares no constructor of its own.

name: Cursor
comments: Reads the enclosing basket's lines through an explicit reference.

name: this[]
comments: An indexer: a property whose symbol is `Item(System.Int32)`.

name: Line
comments: Nested type; C# nesting is always static.

name: Discount
comments: Nested inside a nested type.

name: Batch
comments:
Array members: `counts.Length` binds to `System.Array.Length`, never to a
member of the element type, so no phantom `int` class can be invented here.

name: Allocator
comments: An array allocation expression, and a `Func` from the BCL.

name: Describe
comments: A `dynamic` receiver: the call binds to no symbol and is dropped, counted.

name: Priced
comments: `prices.Length` — a property of `System.Array`, not of `Money`.

name: Size
comments: `counts.Length` — a property of `System.Array`, not of `int`.

name: Channel
comments: Where an order came from. The underlying type is the enum's declared type.

name: EmptyBasketException
comments: The corpus-declared exception the throw-site case targets.

name: IDiscountable
comments: An order that can be marked down. Extends another corpus interface.

name: IPriceable
comments: Anything the pricing engine can put a number on.

name: Money
comments: Minor units only; this fixture has no currencies. A positional record struct.

name: op_Addition
comments: An operator: its symbol is the metadata name `op_Addition`.

name: Notifications
comments: Delivery hooks. Nothing invocable in here has a name of its own — except the local function.

name: Both
comments: Two lambdas STARTING ON THE SAME LINE — the column keeps their ids apart.

name: FreeOf
comments: An anonymous method and a local function, side by side.

name: Order
comments: The second declaration part of Order: same entity, its own file.
A customer order. Partial: the audited half lives in Order.Audit.cs.

name: OrderService
comments:
Billing and archival. Both Archive overloads take a parameter whose simple
name is `List`; only their namespaces differ — and one is generic.

name: Reporting
comments: Monthly reporting helpers: LINQ, a using alias, `using static`, generics.

name: Describe
comments: A switch expression: each arm is a branch.

name: Repository
comments: Non-generic `Repository`: legally coexists with `Repository<T>` below.

name: Repository
comments: Generic arity is part of the symbol: `Repository`1`, never merged with the one above.

name: Résumé
comments: Non-ASCII identifiers and text: the JSON writer must leave them unescaped, as JSON.stringify does — «naïve» — and a tab\tin a comment must be escaped.

name: ShipmentHandler
comments: A delegate: a type that is also invocable.

name: StockGuard
comments:
Throw-site case: a guard clause and a rethrow must each emit a `throws`
edge anchored at its own statement.

name: LedgerAdapter
comments:
Posts to the ledger and keeps a local trail. `MegaCorp.Ledger` and
`Newtonsoft.Json` are referenced by nothing under the source roots, so
`LedgerClient`, `AuditTrail` and `JsonConverter` are error types: stubs
in the reserved `<unresolved>` module, named as written.

name: TrailConverter
comments: An unresolved base type in a nested, block-scoped namespace declaration.

name: MoneyExtensions
comments: Extension methods: children of this static class, attached to the extended type.

name: List
comments: A hand-rolled cons list from before System.Collections was allowed here.
